name: Whispering Spirits

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation

stealth.details: (trained) to hear the whispers from a distance

disable: DC 16 Religion check (trained) to suppress the spirits or DC 16 Performance check (trained) to drown them out
reset: The underlying spirits remain, resetting the haunt every midnight, until what truly happened here becomes public.

items.name: Luring Whispers
items.text:
Trigger Multiple creatures remain in area C4 for more than 6 seconds.

---

Effect The whispers become more insistent until each character in the room must attempt a DC 18 Will save save.

On a failure, a creature is Confused for 1 round (or for 1d6+1 rounds on a critical failure). Both the audible whispers and the babbling of the confused are related to the haunting's origin.

Owners |
Whispers and Babbles |

Archdevil worshippers |
Desperate praise of Mephistopheles |

Soulbound dollmakers |
Pleading "don't make me go in the doll again" |

Alchemical experimenters |
Frantic claims of not wanting to live forever anymore |

Slavers |
Begging to be allowed to be released in multiple languages |

Crime lords |
Promising not to mess with the family again |

Misguided Pharasmins |
Sighing desires to be put to rest |

text: Lost spirits whisper, reliving their last moments, ready to drag the living into their illusion.
